messages:
maria.partnerships: Heads-up 1: Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant want a coordinated marketplace listing + joint announcement in mid-September. Partners propose a public lift between Sept 14-20. Need a compact preflight checklist: legal/DPA, embargo time, staging creds, ingest method, telemetry quotas, and marketplace manifest (SKU + regions). Who takes the lead on embargo?

sam.eng: I can own staging infra. We can provision by 2024-09-10. Clarify: will partners push sample data to S3 or use our staging uploader? Also recommend a throttled demo endpoint (200rps baseline, 1k burst) to avoid noisy neighbor issues.

leo-pm: Marketing prefers Sept 16 for simultaneous PR. That gives partners a business day before for last checks. +1 to 9/10 staging.

natalie-legal: I'll need to review sample datasets for PII and retention. If partners send synthetic data it's faster. Also DPA sign-off required for EU region listings before public launch.

amy-marketing: I can coordinate press assets. Need partner-approved one-liners and logos today. Proposed embargo: 2024-09-16 09:00 PT. Can someone upload a draft press release to the shared drive?

deploy-bot: Provisioned cluster: redwood-staging-3976549 (owner: sam.eng). Temporary creds posted to #secrets (auto-delete 7d).

sam.eng: Telemetry plan: default cap 1000 reqs/s with burst to 2k for short windows; for the demo we'll enforce 200rps steady and allow scheduled spikes. We can set per-connector quotas in manifest. @maria.partnerships need expected concurrency per partner.

maria.partnerships: Partners estimate ~200rps each; HW partner warned they might spike to 1k during throughput demo. We'll ask them to gate spikes but plan autoscaling + auto-throttle fallback.

leo-pm: Draft runbook for coordination: 
```
- Legal & DPA sign-off (natalie-legal)
- Staging cluster + creds (sam.eng)
- Ingest method + sample data (partners)
- Telemetry caps & alerts (eng-sre)
- Connector manifest (partnerships)
- Press embargo & assets (amy-marketing)
- Go/no-go checklist 24h ahead
```

natalie-legal: I'll aim to finish redaction and DPA items by EOD Friday; synthetic data will speed this. If partners delay, we can't list EU regions.

amy-marketing: I'll chase logos and one-liners now and upload the PR draft to the drive link in this thread. Also need final SKU + pricing tier for the marketplace manifest.

maria.partnerships: Uploaded a draft marketplace manifest template and a placeholder blurb. Manifest needs: name, version, supported regions, recommended hardware, telemetry endpoint, support contact.

sam.eng: Example manifest snippet to include: 
```
name: "redwood-connector-snow-dbx-qdrant"
version: "0.9.0"
regions: ["us-west-2","eu-west-1"]
supported_hardware: ["NVIDIA-A100","CPU-x86_64"]
telemetry_endpoint: "https://telemetry.redwood.example/v1/emit"
support_contact: "partners@redwood.example"
```

maria.partnerships: Great. I'll collect partner logos + confirm pricing tiers. Tentative follow-up sync: Thurs 10:00am PT to lock embargo and final checklist. Sending invite now. :calendar:

leo-pm: I'll attend. Bring final timing & partner approvals.

amy-marketing: +1, I'll present the press timeline and distribution list.

natalie-legal: +1, will bring DPA status and any required redaction notes.

sam.eng: +1, will bring staging access details and telemetry knobs.

maria.partnerships: Thanks everyone 10. I'll update this thread with partner replies and the calendar invite. If partners approve earlier we'll accelerate.
